story_arcs.title: Scales, Tails, and Safe People: Heather, Wesley & The Road to North Lion
story_arcs.subtitle: 2003–2028 • Wesley's Chesapeake Blowout, Ten Years Behind the Lens & Two Shared Families
story_arcs.description: Experience Heather Lindstrom's story alongside her non-verbal cousin Wesley—from the Saturday morning Wesley blew up over losing his first guy buddy Nate through building North Lion Scales & Tails in Maplewood and standing together in the restored White House Rose Garden.

stops.title: Part 1: The Empty Pretzel Table, The Oak Frame Off the Shelf, & Why Wesley Blew Up
stops.subtitle: Saturday Pretzel Day, The Empty Shelf, & The Boy Without a Phone Bridge • Scales, Tails, and Safe People
stops.chap_title: Saturday Pretzel Day, The Empty Shelf, & The Boy Without a Phone Bridge
stops.location: Chesapeake, VA (Aunt Linda & Uncle Greg Collins's Split-Level Home)
stops.excerpt: Five days after ending things with Nate outside Room 204, seventeen-year-old Heather tells fifteen-year-old Wesley they aren't meeting Nate at Emerald Creek Mall—triggering a furious, heartbroken blowout.

stops.title: Five Red X's on the Wall Calendar: Wesley's Perspective on the Morning He Thought He Lost Nate Forever
stops.subtitle: From Fifteen-Year-Old Non-Verbal Wesley Sorenson's Third-Person Limited Point of View — Why Heather's Breakup Felt Like Losing His Only Guy Friend on Earth
stops.location: Chesapeake, Virginia (Wesley's Upstairs Bedroom & Living Room)
stops.excerpt: While Katie & Nathaniel follows Nate in Virginia Beach and The Story of Heather Lindstrom follows Heather in Chesapeake, this companion scene enters fifteen-year-old non-verbal Wesley Sorenson's own third-person limited perspective on Saturday morning, January 11, 2003—revealing the sheer terror of having zero phone, bus, or spoken bridge to his very first guy friend when Heather messed up.

stops.title: Part 2: Two Taps on the Glass Every Saturday & Five Months of Frozen Pride
stops.subtitle: Saturday Pretzel Day, The Empty Shelf, & The Boy Without a Phone Bridge • Scales, Tails, and Safe People
stops.chap_title: Saturday Pretzel Day, The Empty Shelf, & The Boy Without a Phone Bridge
stops.location: Chesapeake & Virginia Beach, VA (Aunt Linda's House & Northwood High School)
stops.excerpt: Four days after watching Kristen Bauer demolish Tyler's double-down lie about Cousin Hannah in the Northwood cafeteria, Heather faces Wesley's weekly plea to go apologize to Nate and Katie.

stops.title: Workstation Three, Cousin Hannah's Green Parka, & Why Heather Knew There Was No Restore Point
stops.subtitle: Inside Senior Homeroom 212 on January 6, Five Weeks of Empty Floor in Room 204, & The Cafeteria Lie That Left Heather Sick With Herself
stops.location: Northwood High School (Homeroom 212, Room 204 Computer Lab, Commons Cafeteria, & Stairway A Bus Loop), Virginia Beach, Virginia
stops.excerpt: What happened outside Nathaniel's first-person view between January and June 2003—from Tyler's homeroom ambush on January 6 and five weeks of silence in Mr. Callahan's Room 204 lab to Cousin Hannah's green parka, Wesley's Pomp and Circumstance heartbreak at graduation, and one final pretzel afternoon at Emerald Creek Mall before Heather and Wesley moved home to Minnesota.

stops.title: Thirteen Hundred Miles Away in Maplewood: Missing Postcards, Seeing Katie on TV, & A Very Cautious Request
stops.subtitle: Why Twenty-Eight-Year-Old Wesley Was Overjoyed Watching Meet the Nation, How Heather Explained State Government Without Big Words, & Ten Quiet Weeks Waiting in Filtered Requests
stops.location: Maplewood, Minnesota (Heather & Dan Lindstrom's Family Living Room)
stops.excerpt: What happened inside Heather and Dan Lindstrom's snowy Maplewood, Minnesota home in February and March 2016—from twenty-eight-year-old Wesley missing his Virginia bus postcards and cheering at Katie and Nate on Sunday morning television to trying to figure out what state government is and convincing Heather to send one very cautious message across thirteen years.

stops.title: Architectural Blueprint & Visitor Guide: Inside North Lion Scales & Tails (Maplewood, MN)
stops.subtitle: Zero-Step Automatic Sliding Doors, The Front Supply Store & Customer Service Counter, Dr. Meyer's Vet Clinic, & Three Barrier-Free Zoo Wings for Turtles, Reptiles, and Small Mammals
stops.location: 1618 White Bear Avenue, Maplewood, Minnesota (Twin Cities Transit Route 64)
stops.excerpt: A complete room-by-room architectural guide to Heather and Dan Lindstrom's barrier-free Maplewood facility—explaining how the front retail store, customer service counter, exotic vet clinic, skylit greenhouse conservatory, reptile galleries, and small mammal meadow fit together under one zero-step roof.

stops.title: While the Classroom Door Was Closed: Staff Member Wesley, Cousin Chelsea, & Matching Blue Gloves at the Turtle Lagoon
stops.subtitle: The Full Twenty-Minute Conservatory Scene Between Wesley, Chelsea, Jonas, Nora, Molly, Brittany, and Dan During Nate, Katie, and Heather's Private Reckoning
stops.location: Maplewood, Minnesota (Centerpiece Painted-Turtle Lagoon, North Lion Scales & Tails Reptile Zoo)
stops.excerpt: Because Katie & Nathaniel is told strictly in Nathaniel's first-person perspective, the main novel follows Nate, Katie, and Heather behind the closed door of the Education Classroom. This Backstage scene stays out in the sunlit conservatory to show the joyful twenty minutes Staff Member Wesley and Cousin Chelsea spend feeding Clover, Scooter, and Barnaby in matching blue gloves.

stops.title: Architectural & Family Guide: Two Mirrored Ground-Floor Companion Suites & Our Six-Person Alaskan King
stops.subtitle: How Our Family Built Identical Zero-Step Connected Turtle & Companion Suites in Virginia Beach and Alexandria While Keeping All Six Together Every Night
stops.location: Virginia Beach, Virginia (Kempsville) & Alexandria, Virginia (Sunset Drive)
stops.excerpt: Once U.S. Senator Katie Prairie's 2028 Supported Companions, Waiver Portability, and Social Security Solvency Act takes effect on January 1, 2029, David, Katie, Nate, Heather, and Brittany unveil two inch-for-inch mirrored ground-floor companion suites in Virginia Beach and Alexandria—giving Wesley and Chelsea their own connected daytime sanctuary while keeping all six together every night on their solid-oak Alaskan King.
